file_id: Devara Muralikrishna, vs State Of Telangana, on 7 October, 2025

sentences.text:
Devara Muralikrishna, vs State Of Telangana, on 7 October, 2025
 The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Tirumala Devi Eada
 Criminal Petition No.12892 of 2025
Order:

entities.text: Devara Muralikrishna, vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS), to direct the respondent to direct the respective branch managers of the bank to transfer Rs.
2,62,800/- (Rupees Two Lakh Sixty-Two Thousand Eight Hundred Only) to the petitioner's bank account.

Alternatively, to direct the learned XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Hyderabad, to number the Crl.M.P.Sr.No.8072 of 2024 filed on 15.07.2024 (Resubmission Sr.No.1659 of 2025) in Crime No. 2530 of 2023.

entities.text:
XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Ms. Samhitha Devara, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks a direction to the XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, to number Crl.M.P.Sr.No.8072 of 2024, filed on 15.07.2024 and resubmitted as Sr. No. 1659 of 2025 in Crime No. 2530 of 2023, and to adjudicate the same in the interest of justice.
ETD, J Crl.P_12892_2025 4.

entities.text: XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted to pass appropriate orders.
The petitioner is the de facto complainant in Crime No. 2530 of 2023, registered for offences under Sections 419 and 420 of IPC, and Sections 66(C) and 66(D) of the IT Act.
He filed Crl.M.P.No.8072 of 2024 seeking release of the amount seized during the investigation.

However,
the petition has not been numbered since 2024.
It was initially filed as Crl.M.P.No.8072 of 2024 and later resubmitted as Sr.No.1659 of 2025.

Therefore, the learned XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, is directed to number the petition and decide it on its own merits, without being influenced by any observations made by this Court.

entities.text: XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. With the above direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA 07.10.2025 vjb/lk ETD, J Crl.P_12892_2025 THE HON'BLE SMT.
